reason: P17 finishes four chat-workspace leftovers. (1) streamChat maps Core's queued/admitted frames so the live queue position renders through the existing waiting row; the first queued frame is held 400 ms so a turn a free slot admits at once never shows a position. (2) ContainerTerminalPanel reads terminal audit health through startVisiblePoll only while the terminal is shown. (3) GET /chat/sessions/{id}/subagents answers 304 on a content ETag and the subagent rail sends If-None-Match. (4) Red tests on main: operator rows keep their floating time/actions unclipped by content-visibility and a short bubble keeps its actions in one row (durable-conversation-core desktop/compact); the queued-message and in-place editors opt out of the selected-text toolbar that covered Save on WebKit 390; App.test mocks the credential check #548 added; the two full-App vitest cases get CI's 15 s budget. Python covers the new 304 route contract and the existing subagent route tests. Frontend covers the stream mapping and hold, the conditional client and hook, the terminal poll, the queue editor, selection actions, and the App/SessionsPage files touched. Playwright runs entry:assistant on desktop, mobile Chromium and mobile WebKit (SessionsPage changed; new queue-position, operator-actions and terminal-audit idle assertions), the chat-stream-follow mocked and real-Core areas (new mocked and real-Core queue journeys), chat-subagents mocked and real-Core, durable-conversation-core on all four real-Core projects, and the compact-terminal and terminal-assistant areas for ContainerTerminalPanel.
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. Harness, mission, provider adapters, native Rust/Tauri and backend lifecycle code are unchanged and not selected. tests/v3/test_chat_subagents.py is not selected: ChatSubagents.view() and the service are unchanged; only the route wraps the same listing in a conditional read, covered by tests/v3/test_chat_polling_cost.py and tests/v3/test_chat_api.py.
